Episodes 1 to 12 of 18 are authored: 1138 entities, 5,267 exact mentions in original-en and 5,307 in modern-en, 1136 of the 1138 bound in the older edition and 1133 in the modern one, 129 focused tests passing, content revision 2026-09-16.12. NEXT: episode 13 (Nausicaa, 134 paragraphs), the strand at Sandymount. 2,593 paragraphs remain; the long ones are 15 (Circe, 1,441) and 17 (Ithaca, 654); episode 18 (Penelope) is eight paragraphs of monologue and will be the densest in the book.

EPISODE 12 WAS THE BIGGEST SINGLE ADDITION TO THIS PACKAGE: 337 NEW ENTITIES, more than episodes 1 to 11 put together minus one. Five catalogues carry most of them -- the citizen's girdle at 12:50, the Friends of the Emerald Isle at 12:177, the clergy at 12:241, the wedding of the trees at 12:360 and the procession of saints at 12:513. The rule that settled them is the shopfront rule of episode 10: IN A BURLESQUE CATALOGUE THE MEN AND WOMEN ARE CAST AND THE SONGS, PLAYS, NOVELS AND PLACES ARE NOT. So Cuchulin, Peg Woffington, Paracelsus and Lady Godiva are cast off the girdle and the Rose of Castile, the Man for Galway, Dolly Mount, Sidney Parade and Ben Howth are not; and the eighteen foreign delegates and the thirtyfive wedding guests ARE cast, because in their parodies they brawl, bleed, marry and play the organ.

THE PRE-AUTHORING SWEEP IS NOW THE MOST VALUABLE STEP IN THE ROUTINE. BUILD THE PACKAGE AND LIST EVERY BINDING THAT ALREADY STANDS IN THE EPISODE BEFORE READING IT. In episode 12 it found TWO WRONG BINDINGS THAT WERE SHIPPING: the alias SHANNON (granted for the boatclub swell at 10:166) was binding the river at 12:26 and 12:356 and Carrick-on-Shannon at 16:252, and the alias STEPHEN was binding S. STEPHEN PROTOMARTYR at 12:513. The first is now keyed and the second suppressed.

FOURTEEN MORE ALIASES WERE CAUGHT ON THE NEW CARDS BEFORE THEY COULD SHIP, BY RUNNING THE WHOLE-BOOK OCCURRENCE LIST ON EVERY ALIAS: TROY is the city at 2:174, 7:459 and 9:256 and troy measure at 6:296; TERENCE is Terence Mulcahy at 6:323; DANTE is Mrs Riordan at 17:119; MACMAHON is a Paris bar at 3:44; JUMBO is Ben Jumbo Dollard at 15:699; BLACKWOOD is sir John Blackwood and Blackwood Price in episode 2; CELESTINE is a pope at 17:7; FINTAN is James Fintan Lalor at 17:475; CUMMINS is the author of The Lamplighter at 13:71; BRIDE is Bride Street at 3:6 AND INSIDE THIS EPISODE AT 12:205; GARRYOWEN is the tune at 15:1326; GILTRAP is a family name at 13:20; BARNEY KIERNAN is the premises everywhere but 12:188. All fourteen are keyed.

FOUR ALIASES MATCHED NOTHING AT ALL AND WOULD HAVE SHIPPED AS SILENT OMISSIONS -- read the omittedEntities line of the validation report on every build, it is what reports them. SHEILA sits inside Gutenberg italics (_Sheila, my own_), the fifth instance of the library-wide italic trap; ROSE OF VITERBO is never written in full, because Joyce writes 'the saints Rose of Lima and of Viterbo'; DEADWOOD DICK is plural in the text; and JACOB AGUS JACOB has its middle word in italics. H. RUMBOLD at 12:150 is a fifth italic case that the shorter alias Rumbold happened to cover.

TWO CARDS WERE ABOUT TO BE DUPLICATED AND THE BUILDER CAUGHT BOTH: old Methusalem Bloom at 12:461, Virag at 12:492 and 12:505 and Nagyaságos uram LIPOTI VIRAG at 12:551 are RUDOLPH BLOOM, whose card has carried him unnamed since episode 6; and LANTY MACHALE had been written twice, once as the man and once as his goat. WHEN A LATER EPISODE NAMES SOMEBODY AN EARLIER ONE ONLY DESCRIBED, EXTEND THE EXISTING CARD.

A REPEATED DICT LITERAL IN SPLIT OR PHRASE SHADOWS THE EARLIER ONE AND EVERY KEY IN IT CEASES TO EXIST. It happened again here: a new (12,172) PHRASE entry for Sara Curran silently dropped the City Arms old one and her nephew, and the omittedEntities line was what showed it. Tables.test_no_split_or_phrase_key_is_declared_twice parses the source and fails on any repeated key -- RUN IT BEFORE TRUSTING A BUILD.

THE MODERN EDITION OF EPISODE 12 CHANGES NO NAME AT ALL. It is the lightest modernisation in the book: twentyone paragraphs of archaic-word swaps and ONE SYSTEMATIC INTERPOLATION -- every 'the citizen' becomes 'the Citizen (the nationalist)', seventy times, and nowhere else in the book. That is the second gloss this edition has been caught adding, after 'Henry Flower (Bloom's pen name)' at 11:203 and 11:617. Both are recorded as source defects and neither is bound. No edition byte was touched. This lane never sets appStatus.

THE BUILD NOW TAKES ABOUT TWENTY MINUTES OF CPU for both editions. Run it in the background and wait on the log; do not poll.
